title: A mention is evidence of a data item or component
description:
As a corpus reviewer, I want a line to be called a mention, evidence, or span, so that we do not pretend a line is the data item.

Feature: mention as evidence

  Scenario: Line is not the data item
    Given a data item for email
    And an evidence span on user.ts line 8
    When I read the graph
    Then the data item identity is not the line number
    And the span is attached as evidence

  Scenario: Component still uses a span as a receipt
    Given a component asset:database
    And evidence on models.py lines 4-6
    When I read the graph
    Then the component identity is type:name
    And the span is evidence, not a second component
